description: This file is a Python script that manages build system snippets, including parsing snippet YAML files, validating them, and generating CMake configuration code for Zephyr build system.

classes.name: Snippet
classes.description: Represents an individual code snippet with associated configuration data.

classes.name: Snippets
classes.description: Container for all discovered snippets, mapping snippet names to Snippet objects.

classes.name: SnippetsError
classes.description: Custom exception class for signaling errors during snippet processing.

classes.name: SnippetToCMakePrinter
classes.description: Helper class for generating CMake configuration code from snippets data.

methods.name: _new_append
methods.description: Creates a new defaultdict list for appends.

methods.name: _new_board2appends
methods.description: Creates a new defaultdict of appends for boards.

methods.name: process_data
methods.description: Processes snippet data loaded from YAML, validating file paths and storing configuration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes Snippets container with optional requested snippet list.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes SnippetToCMakePrinter with snippets data and output file.

methods.name: print_cmake
methods.description: Generates the CMake configuration code for all snippets.

methods.name: print_cmake_for
methods.description: Generates CMake code for a specific snippet.

methods.name: print_appends
